stories.title: Netanyahu defends military action as delegates walk out at UN
stories.summary: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu defended Israel's military operations in a UN General Assembly speech as some delegates walked out, drawing fresh backlash from journalists and broadcasters.

stories.title: Trump denies barred media access to state dinner despite court order
stories.summary: Several outlets Trump has barred were kept out of a White House state-dinner event even after a judge ordered their access restored, as Trump welcomed China's Xi Jinping for an official visit.

stories.title: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope Leo's visit
stories.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people are expected to turn out in Paris for Pope Leo's visit, shaping up as one of the largest papal events the city has hosted in years.

stories.title: Tesla moves to electrify trucking after decade of delays
stories.summary: Tesla says it will scale production of its all-electric Semi to 50,000 units a year, its biggest push into freight trucking after roughly a decade of work and delays.

stories.title: Runway launches Layers to split images into editable layers
stories.summary: Runway launched Layers, a tool that splits any image into individually editable transparent components with a single click, aimed at faster image editing workflows.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude solved nine-loop physics calculation
stories.summary: Anthropic reported that its Claude model computed a nine-loop particle-physics scattering amplitude in planar N=4 super Yang-Mills theory, surpassing the previous eight-loop record set by physicists.

stories.title: Perplexity launches Fast Search API on new Photon engine
stories.summary: Perplexity launched Fast Search, a new Search API preset powered by its in-house Photon retrieval-and-ranking engine, aimed at lower-latency programmatic search.

stories.title: Quincy Williams becoming a problem the Browns can't ignore
stories.summary: Linebacker Quincy Williams is quickly becoming a problem for opposing offenses, and the Browns can't keep ignoring his impact as they prep for the Panthers.

stories.title: Delpit injury could open role for rookie McNeil-Warren
stories.summary: Grant Delpit's shoulder injury could give Browns rookie Emmanuel McNeil-Warren his biggest defensive role yet in Week 3 against Carolina.

stories.title: Nick Chubb's retirement message to Browns fans
stories.summary: Nick Chubb, set to sign a one-day contract and retire with Cleveland ahead of Sunday's home opener, shared an emotional thank-you message to Browns fans.

stories.title: Browns defense still vulnerable in one key area
stories.summary: Cleveland's defense improved from Week 1 to Week 2 but remains exposed in a specific area that could undermine the unit if left unfixed.

stories.title: No. 7 Ohio State opens Big Ten play hosting Illinois
stories.summary: No. 7 Ohio State hosts Illinois in Saturday's Big Ten opener; kickoff is Noon ET on FOX for the 105th meeting for the Illibuck Trophy.

stories.title: Ohio State struggling in short-yardage situations
stories.summary: The Buckeyes have converted just five of 11 third- and fourth-and-short plays inside three yards this season, an area needing improvement with Big Ten play looming.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Illinois preview: running backs must step up
stories.summary: Ohio State's Illinois preview looks at a backfield that needs to step up in conference play, with Devin Sanchez drawing a key matchup.

stories.title: F1 approves shorter races for 2027 season
stories.summary: Formula 1 approved shorter races for the 2027 season to fit the revised power-unit plan, a significant format change for the sport.

stories.title: Steiner predicts Verstappen will go winless in 2026
stories.summary: Former Haas boss Guenther Steiner predicts Max Verstappen will not win a race in the 2026 F1 season, citing Red Bull's current struggles.

stories.title: Pin sets timeline for F1 race seat
stories.summary: 2025 F1 Academy champion Doriane Pin laid out her target timeline for reaching a Formula 1 race seat as she pushes toward the top of the sport.

stories.title: Red Bull admits Verstappen car issue may not be fixed until 2027
stories.summary: Red Bull says the mysterious issue hurting Verstappen's car cannot be fully resolved before the 2027 season, explaining the team's ongoing performance gap.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: Central Ohio cities are split over how to use Flock automated-license-plate cameras, balancing public safety benefits against privacy concerns.

stories.title: One killed in Columbus South Side shooting
stories.summary: Police are investigating after one person was found dead in an alley on Columbus's South Side. No arrests have been reported.

stories.title: List: Columbus-area top home sales for August
